implemented: Optional viewer-bound coordination state, separate from native host input ownership
Separate publisher capability on existing authenticated loopback service; no additional external listener
Receiver-monotonic, one-use observation challenges; expiring, epoch-bound single-controller turn permissions
Finite bounded stdin/stdout source command and private nonce-bound mailbox
Existing-viewer CUA observer; URL/AX binding, explicit trusted owner UID, fail-closed UI parsing
Automatic wait-for-turn and before/after cooperating-action checks, retaining partial outcomes without replay

source_tests.scope: Full source suite with real existing native executable and pinned base; fresh venv installed matching wheel, no inherited PYTHONPATH

installed_checks.scope: Isolated Python -I in fresh ordinary wheel venv, copied authored test/native fixtures outside checkout; includes 10 existing native/input checks

observer_checks.scope: Node UI parser, bounded private mailbox, URL binding, corruption/timeout/permission and restricted-runtime configuration checks

source_distribution.scope: Candidate archive content check; final archive identities stay in private build receipts

live_viewer_to_local_receiver.receiver_location: Local Mac data-only witness; not Dot headless/cloud deployment
live_viewer_to_local_receiver.transport: Fresh CUA snapshots to private local mailbox, real Python command stdin/stdout, actual OwnershipState receiver
live_viewer_to_local_receiver.first_runtime_attempts: UID lookup unavailable in restricted CUA runtime; no control changes or grants. Explicit trusted ownerUid configuration corrected the observer; all qualified samples are from the corrected run.

cloud_gate.latest_managed_task_result: Reported repository-access failure before runtime command startup; no fresh SSH receipt
cloud_gate.configuration_readback: Saved operations environments show Unknown repository; edit action disabled in inspected current UI
cloud_gate.account_readback: Two existing GitHub connections are visible; both display the same account label. Independent CLI account checks show account-specific access to the private operations repository. Selected Cloud connection binding remains unestablished.
cloud_gate.historical_route: Prior receipts show successful managed Tailscale SSH for the retained operations task; not current reachability or ordinary Dot-shell evidence

limits: Sampled English viewer UI evidence; not a supported server ownership subscription or atomic capture lease
Transitions entirely between polls may be missed; freshness expiry bounds stale evidence, not transition latency
Checks fence cooperating callers only; unrelated desktop tools and input already in flight remain owned by the outer harness
No Dot headless/cloud receiver deployment or SSH transport qualification; no live desktop action through run_turn_step
No whole-computer identity attestation; bind the intended viewer and session explicitly
Source commands are trusted operator configuration, not a command sandbox
Native executable reused and not rebuilt; no portable library, Windows, release or global install qualification
connection=live reflects the sampled viewer UI, not an independent server liveness check; a stalled UI may retain labels
publication: Authored code, tests, docs, compact results and hashes only; raw AX/screenshots/chats/routes, credentials, private account aliases, runtime IDs and viewer URLs remain private
